general_information.Description: Advanced Generative AI (AGA) studies how modern large language models (LLMs) and the generative-AI stack are built, adapted, evaluated, and deployed. This technology is one of the most rapidly evolving areas of machine learning, and demand is growing for professionals able to construct, fine-tune, align, and ship production-quality LLM-based systems. The course covers transformer architectures and data preparation, foundational and transformer-based language modelling, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA), advanced alignment (RLHF, PPO, DPO), and the design of LLM-powered applications using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), LangChain, and AI agents. By the end of this specialization, students will be ready to design generative-AI applications that perform text generation, classification, translation, retrieval-augmented question answering, and build LLM-powered agents.
general_information.StudentTasks: Student must get the certification of Generative AI Engineering with LLMs Specialization from Coursera to be accepted to the final examination
general_information.Note: 1. Complete the online course to be allowed to take Final Exam 2. Final Exam is included of Final Theory Exam (TE) & Final Practical Exam (PE): 100% 3. Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded. 4. Completion Criteria: Final TE Score >=4 & Final PE Score >=4 & FR >= 5 (FR = min(10, (Final TE Score + Final PE Score)/2 + bonus)

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Distinguish the major generative-AI model families and implement tokenization and PyTorch data pipelines.
Build NLP systems using foundational language-modelling techniques
Apply transformer LLMs to generation, classification, translation, and understanding tasks.
Adapt LLMs for domain tasks using PEFT, instruction tuning, and alignment
Design, build, and deploy production LLM applications using RAG, vector stores, and agent patterns.
